'''Vemrin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], seeking to become the apprentice of [[Darth Baras]].

==Biography==
Originally from Balmorra, he and his friend [[Dolgis]] were brought to Korriban to become Sith acolytes, in accordance with the law that all Force-sensitives in Imperial territory be trained at the Academy. Vemrin became a self-proclaimed enemy of the [[Empire's Wrath|new acolyte]] tutored by [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Tremel]].<ref name="TOR:AY" /> Vemrin sent Dolgis to ambush and attack the new acolyte, but the latter would survive this encounter.<ref name="TOR:StB">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Slaying the Beast|Korriban}}</ref> During their final trial, Vemrin was ordered to go to Baras' quarters and await further instructions, while his rival ventured into the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow|Tomb]] of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] to retrieve an ancient lightsaber. Vemrin disobeyed Baras and sought to kill the acolyte in the tomb, but his arrogance proved to be his undoing as his rival managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.<ref name="TOR:TFT" />

==Personality and traits==
Vemrin was both ruthless and strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], having already earned some favor with Baras by the time Tremel's protégé arrived in Korriban.<ref name="TOR:TFT" /> He considered himself superior to the newcomer because, while the Sith Warrior had been handed every advantage by Tremel, Vemrin had to fight and compete for his status on Korriban. Thus, Vemrin felt he had earned his place.<ref name="TOR:AY" /> He wielded a [[Sith sword|Sith warblade]].<ref name="TOR:TFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
After defeating Vemrin, the player can choose to kill him without another word (dark side dialogue) or call him a worthy opponent (light side dialogue). If the latter dialogue is chosen, Vemrin refused to be pitied and asked for an honorable death, which the Warrior then provides him. Either way, he will die nonetheless.
